City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY

15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
OCTOBER 13, 2015
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Holloway, Munoz, Argudo, Klinakis and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of Sunset Elementary and Workman Elementary School Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Certificates of Appreciation - Law Enforcement Participation at the Independence Day Celebration on July 3, 2015
Certificates of Recognition - John Garside and Marty Shields for Educating the Public on the City's History
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF SEPTEMBER 22, 2015 AND SEPTEMBER 29, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of September 22, 2015 and September 29, 2015.
A-1 Minutes 9-22-15 CC-SA
A-1 Minutes 9-29-15 CC-SA

PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1395 AND 37
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5238 approving Warrant Register No. 1395 and Resolution No. SA 15-56 approving Warrant Register No. 37.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1395
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #37
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BARR & CLARK, INC. FOR ASBESTOS AND LEAD CONSULTING SERVICES IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $30,000
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 15-5236 dispensing with the Cityâ€™s competitive bidding requirements; (2) approve the Professional Services Agreement with Barr & Clark, Inc.; and (3) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-2 Barr and Clark Staff Report
D-2 Barr and Clark Attachment A List
D-2 Barr and Clark Attachment B Agreement
D-2 Barr and Clark Attachment C Resolution
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT NO 13-1131 BETWEEN THE CITY AND DAVID CARMANY FOR CITY MANAGER SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 1 to Employment Agreement No. 13-1131 between the City and Employee; and (2) authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on the Cityâ€™s behalf.
D-3 City Manager Staff Report
D-3 City Manager Attachment A Agreement
D-4
ACCEPTANCE AND RECORDATION OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR CYCLE 10 SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL (SR2S) PROGRAM FOR STREET AND PEDESTRIAN IMPROVEMENTS IN THE VICINITY OF LA PUENTE HIGH SCHOOL, SIERRA VISTA MIDDLE SCHOOL AND WORKMAN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL [SR2SL-5331(018)]
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) accept the project as complete; and (2) authorize the City Clerk to record the Notice of Completion.
D-4 Safe Routes to Schools Staff Report
D-4 Safe Routes to Schools Attachment A NOC
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT, INC. FOR TRAFFIC DETOUR AND CONTROL SERVICES FOR CITY COMMUNITY EVENTS IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $75,000.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the amendment to the agreement with Traffic Management, Inc. for traffic detour and control services for City community events; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-5 TMI Amendment Staff Report
D-5 TMI Amendment Attachment A
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS PERTAINING TO THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION OF TUESDAY, APRIL 12, 2016
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 15-5239 calling for the holding of a General Municipal Election on Tuesday, April 12, 2016, for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law Cities; (2) adopt Resolution No. 15-5240 adopting regulations for candidates for elective office pertaining to candidates statements submitted to the voters at the General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, April 12, 2016; and (3) adopt Resolution No. 15-5241 requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to Render Specified Services to the City Relating to the Conduct of a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, April 12, 2016.
D-6 Election Staff Report
D-6 Election Attachment A Resolution Calling for Election
D-6 Elections Attachment B Resolution re Candidate Statement
D-6 Election Attachment C Resolution re County Services
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A LOAN AGREEMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $5,952,908 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR MITIGATION OF NOISE, TRAFFIC, AND RAILROAD IMPACTS ALONG VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Loan Agreement between the City of La Puente and the City of Industry for mitigation of noise, traffic, and railroad impacts along Valley Boulevard; and (2) authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
E-1 Valley Wall Funding Staff Report
E-1 Valley Wall Funding Attachment A Agreement
E-1 Valley Wall Funding Attachment B Concept Plan

ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
